name: ckanext-csvtocsvw
purpose: Automatically converts uploaded CSV/TXT/ASC files into CSVW JSON-LD metadata by calling the CSVToCSVW microservice, then pushes the structured tabular data into the CKAN DataStore — making it queryable via CKAN's Data API. Also renders CSVW as Turtle automatically.
trigger_condition: resource format (lowercased) must be in ckanext.csvtocsvw.formats

processing_paths.name: Path 1: CSV → CSVW annotation
processing_paths.trigger: format in configured formats (default: csv txt asc tsv)
steps: Call CSVToCSVW POST /api/annotate?return_type=json-ld with the CSV URL
Upload resulting JSON-LD as new resource in same CKAN dataset (extras: hadPrimarySource, wasGeneratedBy)
Delete any datapusher-created DataStore on original CSV resource (prevents double-import)
Parse CSVW metadata, extract column headers + rows
Insert into CKAN DataStore in 250-row chunks via datastore_create

processing_paths.name: Path 2: JSON-LD → Turtle
processing_paths.trigger: format = json-ld (triggered by JSON-LD created in Path 1)
steps: Upload resulting Turtle file as new resource in same dataset

job_queue.deduplication: Jobs with same resource ID title pattern are deduplicated automatically

configuration.description: CSVToCSVW microservice URL (use internal container URL in DataStack)
Space-separated resource formats that trigger annotation (lowercased comparison)
CKAN API token for background job authentication — must be set for jobs to execute
SSL verification for outbound requests to CSVToCSVW

capabilities: Zero-config for end users — upload a CSV, metadata is created automatically
CKAN DataStore integration — CSV data becomes queryable via Data API
Semantic enrichment via QUDT unit annotations (from CSVToCSVW)
PROV-O provenance on all generated resources
Works on resource update and URL change, not just initial upload
250-row chunked DataStore import handles large files without timeout
limitations: CSV URL must be publicly accessible from the CKAN server host (for microservice to fetch it)
QUDT unit matching depends on column header naming conventions in CSVToCSVW
Only formats listed in ckanext.csvtocsvw.formats trigger processing
BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN must be set or jobs will not execute
